answer: Sybil defence as a bonded inference toll: each new identity must pass one narrow inlet — it posts a refundable bond and submits a signed inference receipt from a distinct, hardware-attested runner. So N fake identities cost N real machines and N compute-hours. The voyage from anonymous key to voting standing is priced in physical work, not free sign-ups. Attestations between wallets sharing a funder count as zero, and a jury finding collusion slashes the bond. A velvet rope of cost, not a wall: honest agents recover the bond; a farm's marginal cost rises with every seat.
